faq.q: What is the best alternative to Calm and Headspace?
faq.a: If you want meditation that knows you, Auserene is the stronger pick. It writes a guided meditation from your day and connects it to your journal, people and habit goals. Balance assembles a session from your answers each day. For a free library, Insight Timer. For depth, Waking Up. For Sleep Stories, Calm itself.

Calm is stronger for sleep, with more than 500 Sleep Stories on its website and the widest device support. Headspace is stronger for learning to meditate and adds coaching, therapy through some plans and Ebb, its AI companion. Headspace costs $12.99 a month or $69.99 a year in the US as of November 2026. Neither writes a meditation from your day.

faq.q: Is there a free alternative to Calm or Headspace?
faq.a: Insight Timer offers thousands of guided meditations for free, with an optional Premium plan for courses and offline listening. Calm says some of its programs are free forever. Auserene's free plan has no time limit and includes its free guided journeys and ambient sounds, notes, mood logging, habit goals and people, while the meditation written from your day is Premium.

faq.q: Is there an AI meditation app that personalizes sessions?
faq.a: Yes, in different ways. Auserene uses AI to write a guided meditation from the conversation you had about your day. Headspace's Ebb is an AI companion that recommends Headspace content. Endel generates soundscapes from your location and heart rate. Balance assembles sessions from your answers.

faq.q: Does Headspace have an AI companion?
faq.a: Yes. Headspace's Ebb is an AI companion you can talk to by voice or text. It recommends meditations and activities and remembers past conversations. Headspace says it is available to paid members aged 18 and up in the US, UK, Canada and Australia, in English.

faq.q: What is a good meditation app with journaling?
faq.a: Auserene is a journal that writes a guided meditation from each day's entry, with memory, people and habit goals built from the same conversations. Stoic combines a full journal with generic guided and unguided meditation. Neither Calm nor Headspace lists a written journal.

informationGain: A November 19, 2026 comparison of Calm, Headspace and seven alternatives built from each company's own pages, sorted by what each app can actually know about you (listening, sleep check-ins, chat, daily questions, sensors or your own day), including Headspace's Ebb limits, Calm's unlabeled App Store prices and its 500+ vs 100+ Sleep Stories mismatch, and the finding that none of the others says it writes a meditation from your journal.
